release_notes: Classic and Modern interface: a rebuilt main window with menu bar, compact toolbar, custom-category sidebar and a seven-column download table.
New Download Complete window with real average speed, completion time, final size, source host, Open File and Open Folder actions and a remembered display setting.
Three themes plus Follow Windows: Classic Light, Modern Light and Modern Dark switch instantly and the choice persists across restarts.
Live download list with a custom-painted progress meter, status chips, search, category filtering and a status bar showing active, queued, transfer rate and total data.
Custom categories created while adding a download or from Tasks > Manage Categories filter the table and keep their selection across edits.
Download engine, queue, scheduler, browser integration, settings and database schema 5 are unchanged; existing data needs no migration.
